meaning: the back (of the body or an object)

senses.en: the back (of the body or an object)

note: This is bèi; the "carry on back" verb is bēi.

examples.zh: 我的背很疼，坐不住。
examples.en: My back hurts and I can't sit still.

examples.zh: 孩子在爸爸的背上笑。
examples.en: The child is laughing on his dad's back.

examples.zh: 游泳对背好，你可以试试。
examples.en: Swimming is good for the back; you could try it.

meaning: state, condition (of a person or thing)

senses.en: state, condition (of a person or thing)

note: Often for mood or form: 状态不好 "not on form".

examples.zh: 我今天状态不好，想早睡。
examples.en: I'm not on form today and want to sleep early.

examples.zh: 手机现在是关机状态。
examples.en: The phone is currently switched off.

examples.zh: 比赛前，他的状态很好。
examples.en: Before the match, he was in great form.

examples.zh: 我家周围有很多商店。
examples.en: There are many shops around my home.

examples.zh: 他看了看周围，没有一个人。
examples.en: He looked around; there wasn't a soul.

examples.zh: 这儿周围有没有药店？
examples.en: Is there a pharmacy around here?

note: Used in news, not for gossip. Noun: 一篇报道.

examples.zh: 我在报纸上看到了一篇报道。
examples.en: I saw a report in the newspaper.

examples.zh: 新闻正在报道明天的天气。
examples.en: The news is reporting tomorrow's weather.

examples.zh: 这篇报道写得很清楚。
examples.en: This report is written very clearly.

note: More formal than 开会; common in work notices.

examples.zh: 下午三点有一场会议。
examples.en: There is a meeting at three in the afternoon.

examples.zh: 经理正在开会议，请你等一会儿。
examples.en: The manager is in a meeting; please wait a moment.

examples.zh: 这次会议取消了吗？
examples.en: Has this meeting been canceled?

note: Slightly formal; speech often uses 到.

examples.zh: 飞机十点到达北京。
examples.en: The plane arrives in Beijing at ten.

examples.zh: 你到达酒店以后，给我发个信息。
examples.en: After you reach the hotel, send me a message.

examples.zh: 火车什么时候到达上海？
examples.en: When does the train arrive in Shanghai?

meaning: to show, to display; to indicate

senses.en: to show, to display; to indicate

note: Used for screens and results: 屏幕显示, 结果显示.

examples.zh: 手机上显示现在是三点。
examples.en: The phone shows that it is now three o'clock.

examples.zh: 检查结果显示，你的身体很好。
examples.en: The test results show that you are in good health.

examples.zh: 电脑上没有显示出来。
examples.en: It doesn't show up on the computer.

examples.zh: 听到电话，他立刻跑了出去。
examples.en: Hearing the call, he ran out at once.

examples.zh: 请你立刻过来一下。
examples.en: Please come over right away.

examples.zh: 吃了药，不会立刻好。
examples.en: After taking medicine, you won't get better right away.

note: Also figurative: 世界舞台 "the world stage".

examples.zh: 她第一次站在舞台上，很紧张。
examples.en: It was her first time on stage and she was nervous.

examples.zh: 舞台上的灯很亮。
examples.en: The lights on the stage are bright.

examples.zh: 这个舞台太小，乐队站不下。
examples.en: This stage is too small for the band to fit.

meaning: to match, to go with; to pair

senses.en: to match, to go with; to pair

examples.zh: 这条裤子你想配什么上衣？
examples.en: What top do you want to match with these pants?

examples.zh: 红色的衣服配黑色的鞋很好看。
examples.en: A red outfit with black shoes looks nice.

examples.zh: 吃饺子配啤酒，太好了。
examples.en: Dumplings with beer is just perfect.

examples.zh: 明天下雨，比赛取消了。
examples.en: It's raining tomorrow, so the match is canceled.

examples.zh: 我想取消明天的机票。
examples.en: I'd like to cancel tomorrow's plane ticket.

examples.zh: 我想取消昨天订的房间。
examples.en: I'd like to cancel the room I booked yesterday.

note: More formal than 等; fits notices and written requests.

examples.zh: 请在这儿等待，医生马上来。
examples.en: Please wait here; the doctor will come soon.

examples.zh: 我一直在等待你的好消息。
examples.en: I've been waiting for your good news.

examples.zh: 等待的时间很长，大家有点儿累了。
examples.en: The wait was long and everyone got a bit tired.

examples.zh: 他们去年离婚了。
examples.en: They got divorced last year.

examples.zh: 她想离婚，但是为了孩子没说。
examples.en: She wants a divorce, but didn't say so for the child's sake.

examples.zh: 你为什么要离婚？
examples.en: Why do you want a divorce?

note: Written/formal; in speech use 还 or 仍然.

examples.zh: 已经十二点了，他仍在工作。
examples.en: It's already twelve, and he's still working.

examples.zh: 虽然下雨，比赛仍会进行。
examples.en: Although it's raining, the match will still go ahead.

examples.zh: 过了这么多年，她仍记得我。
examples.en: After so many years, she still remembers me.

examples.zh: 我们去饭馆庆祝他的生日。
examples.en: We're going to a restaurant to celebrate his birthday.

examples.zh: 大家一起庆祝新年。
examples.en: Everyone celebrates the New Year together.

examples.zh: 你想怎么庆祝？
examples.en: How do you want to celebrate?

examples.zh: 这条裤子太长了。
examples.en: These pants are too long.

examples.zh: 我想买一条黑色的裤子。
examples.en: I want to buy a pair of black pants.

examples.zh: 你的裤子脏了。
examples.en: Your pants are dirty.

examples.zh: 他每天都在实验室工作。
examples.en: He works in the lab every day.

examples.zh: 这间实验室在几楼？
examples.en: Which floor is this lab on?

examples.zh: 进实验室以前，要先洗手。
examples.en: Before entering the lab, wash your hands first.

meaning: to repair, to fix; to build

senses.en: to repair, to fix; to build

examples.zh: 我的自行车坏了，想请人修。
examples.en: My bike is broken and I want someone to fix it.

examples.zh: 我的手机正在修，明天才能用。
examples.en: My phone is being repaired; I can only use it tomorrow.

examples.zh: 你会修手机吗？
examples.en: Can you fix phones?

note: Often health or traffic: 身体状况, 路况/交通状况.

examples.zh: 他的身体状况怎么样？
examples.en: How is his physical condition?

examples.zh: 路上的状况不太好，我们早出发吧。
examples.en: Road conditions aren't great; let's set off early.

examples.zh: 请告诉我公司的状况。
examples.en: Please tell me about the company's situation.

note: Fairly formal; common at work: 确保安全.

examples.zh: 出发前，请确保你带了护照。
examples.en: Before leaving, make sure you have your passport.

examples.zh: 我们要确保大家的安全。
examples.en: We must ensure everyone's safety.

examples.zh: 请确保手机有电。
examples.en: Please make sure your phone has battery.
